Undergraduate & Graduate Positions EOI
Sippy Downs, Queensland, Australia | req2259
Posted on: 27/08/2026
Expression of interest for Graduate/Undergraduate positions at Georgiou
Tertiary Qualifications in Civil Engineering, Environmental Science, HSEQ, Construction Management or related disciplines
Be outcome focused with efficient communication, organisational and problem-solving skills
A passion for civil construction and exposure so construction work would be highly advantageous but no necessary
Develop technical and non-technical skills across Engineering, Project Management, and Tendering
Assists with planning, coordinating and controlling professional activities relating to projects
Complete predetermined competencies within the Graduate Development Program
Apply via Georgiou CSOD careers portal
Contact: hradmin@georgiou.com.au
NSW 02 8072 3600 | QLD 07 3319 4500 | WA & NT 08 9200 2500
www.georgiou.com.au
